A
Accounting PhD with Integrated Study
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
A four-year doctoral programme combining rigorous coursework and original research, designed to develop future scholars in accounting across areas such as accounting and its interlinks with culture and society, sustainability, accountability, critical and interdisciplinary perspective on accounting research.
African Studies PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD African Studies at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme offers an intensive introduction to the study of Africa, grounded in the disciplines of anthropology, politics and history.
Agriculture and Food Security PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Postgradaute research study with Agriculture and Food Security PhD from the University of Edinburgh. This postgraduate degree offers interdisciplinary research and training in support of global food and environmental security, sustainable rural development, and animal and human wellbeing.
Algebra, Geometry and Topology PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study algebra, geometry, number theory and topology as part of the Centre for Doctoral Training in Algebra, Geometry and Quantum Fields. Build a strong abstract foundation in these fields and graduate equipped with innovative problem-solving skills and expertise in advanced computing. Alternatively, you can study a PhD in Algebra, Geometry and Topology through the University of Edinburgh.
Analysis PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Your passion for mathematical analysis will be rewarded by contact with, and supervision by, world-leading academic staff, a rich seminar and working group programme resulting in a qualification that boasts an internationally respected pedigree.
Anatomical Sciences (Biomedical Sciences) PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD in Anatomical Sciences (Biomedical Sciences) at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme encompasses a broad range of subjects and interests, with a common focus on understanding the underlying structure of the body in health or during disease.
Applied and Computational Mathematics PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The Applied and Computational Mathematics research group combines expertise in dynamics, classical and statistical mechanics, advanced scientific computing, and machine learning to develop techniques for applications such as molecular dynamics, geophysical and astrophysical fluid dynamics, atomic energy, and optoelectronics.
Archaeology MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Our Archaeology MSc (by Research) offers you a first-class experience in graduate education and research in a year long format.
Archaeology PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Our PhD in Archaeology offers you the opportunity to study archaeology at an advanced level through independent research.
Architectural History PhD, MPhil
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD or MPhil Architectural History at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme offers expertise across architectural conservation, history, theory and criticism, digital media and design, and technology, environment and sustainability.
Architecture by Design PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD in Architecture by Design at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme includes research on design, sustainability, conservation, environment, landscape, information technology and digital media.
Architecture MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study MSc by Research in Architecture at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme offers expertise across architectural conservation, history, theory and criticism, digital media and design, and technology, environment and sustainability.
Architecture PhD, MPhil
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study our postgraduate research degree in Architecture at the University of Edinburgh. Our programme offers expertise across architectural conservation, history, theory and criticism, digital media and design, and technology, environment and sustainability.
Art PhD, MPhil
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study MPhil or PhD in Art at the University of Edinburgh. Taught at Edinburgh College of Art, this postgraduate degree programme spans the fields of art, design, music, architecture, landscape architecture and history of art.
Astrophysics PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
Based at the historic Royal Observatory Edinburgh, the Institute for Astronomy (IfA) is one of the world’s leading centres in astronomical research.
Atmospheric and Environmental Sciences PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study for a PhD in Atmospheric and Environmental Sciences at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme focuses on understanding and predicting global environmental change.
Back to top
B
Bioengineering MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The MScR Bioengineering programme enables you to complete a research degree as part of the Institute for Bioengineering, a vibrant and varied group whose interests include modelling, biosensing, biomedical signals and biomedical applications of engineering technology.
Biological Sciences (with Internship) PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Undertake a specialised research project in biological sciences under the guidance of experienced supervisors, with opportunities for interdisciplinary research. This programme involves a Professional Internship for PGR Students (PIPS) and experience of a professional work environment.
Biological Sciences PhD, MScR, MPhil
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Undertake a specialised research project in biological sciences under the guidance of highly qualified and experienced supervisors. We strongly encourage interdisciplinary research, working closely with physical sciences, engineering, medical and veterinary sciences.
Biomedical Sciences (Based in China) PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
Our Biomedical Sciences PhD programme is a four-year programme, which provides an exciting and unique opportunity for interdisciplinary research training and development within the field of Biomedical Sciences. You will contribute to the development of disease diagnosis, treatment and prevention in state-of-the-art research and teaching facilities at the International Campus, Zhejiang University, China.
Biomedical Sciences (Life Sciences) MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
A research-intensive masters programme that gives you opportunities to experience two areas of biomedical research, helping you discover your interests, develop as an independent researcher and prepare for PhD study or a research career.
Business Economics PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
The programme offers advanced research training in business economics, supporting students to develop expertise in addressing complex economic and organisational challenges with theoretical and applied approaches.
Back to top
C
Cancer (Edinburgh Cancer Research Centre) PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD or Masters by Research in Cancer (Edinburgh Cancer Research Centre) at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme takes a comprehensive approach to cancer research, combining both laboratory-based research and clinical approaches.
Cancer (Intercalated) PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
This programme is funded by Cancer Research UK and allows medical students to enter a 3-year PhD training programme during their medical degree.
Cardiovascular Science PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The Centre for Cardiovascular Science offers postgraduates the opportunity to work within internationally leading research programmes to address topics across the spectrum of cardiovascular science research.
Celtic Studies and Scottish Studies PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to Celtic Studies and Scottish Studies.
Celtic Studies MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a short piece of postgraduate research in Celtic Studies. On this Masters by Research programme, you'll develop your critical skills and achieve a masters through independent study.
Centre for Doctoral Training - Sensing, Processing, and AI for Defence and Security PhD with Integrated Study, EngD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
This Centre for Doctoral Training (CDT) programme, jointly hosted by the University of Edinburgh and Heriot-Watt University, focuses on generation-after-next technologies for information processing in defence and security, spanning the entire range from hardware development to algorithmic AI development.
Centre for Doctoral Training in Algebra, Geometry and Quantum Fields PhD with Integrated Study
Postgraduate research
Study algebra, geometry and mathematical physics as part of the Centre for Doctoral Training in Algebra, Geometry and Quantum Fields. Build a strong abstract foundation in these fields and graduate equipped with innovative problem-solving skills and expertise in advanced computing.
Centre for Doctoral Training in Artificial Intelligence for Biomedical Innovation PhD with Integrated Study
Postgraduate research
The Centre for Doctoral Training in AI for Biomedical Innovation trains researchers to develop and implement AI solutions to tackle the major global health challenges, optimise healthcare systems and improve patient outcomes.
Centre for Doctoral Training in Designing Responsible Natural Language Processing PhD with Integrated Study
Postgraduate research
The Centre for Doctoral Training (CDT) in Designing Responsible Natural Language Processing (NLP) aims to develop doctoral graduates who can harness the full potential of NLP-based systems and create richer interactions between humans and AI
Centre for Doctoral Training in Machine Learning Systems PhD with Integrated Study
Postgraduate research
This PhD involves training collaborative researchers with experience across systems and machine learning.
Centre for Doctoral Training in Quantum Informatics PhD with Integrated Study
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
In this programme you will gain an understanding of the structure and behaviour of quantum hardware, software and applications, as well as the interactions between them.
Chemistry PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Our postgraduate research degree programme enables you to explore key research areas in chemistry, such as the chemistry-biology interface, energy, environmental and sustainable chemistry, structural chemistry and chemical dynamics, functional materials and chemistry education.
Chinese MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a short piece of postgraduate research in Chinese studies. On this Masters by Research programme, you'll develop your critical skills and achieve a masters through independent study.
Chinese PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to Chinese and East Asian Studies.
Classics MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Our MSc (by Research) in Classics offers you the opportunity to study classics at an advanced level through independent research.
Classics PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The PhD in Classics offers you the opportunity to study classics at an advanced level through independent research.
Clinical Brain Sciences PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
This programme integrates laboratory and clinical research to study the causes, consequences and treatment of major brain disorders.
Clinical Education PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD in Clinical Education at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme is ideal for those wishing to further their career in academic clinical or medical education.
Clinical Psychology MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The MSc by Research programme in Clinical and Health Psychology provides the opportunity to do a substantial piece of research in an area linked to clinical and health psychology and therefore develop excellent research skills in the process.
Clinical Psychology PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The PhD Clinical Psychology programme provides the opportunity to do a substantial piece of research in an area linked to clinical and health psychology and to develop excellent research skills in the process.
Clinical Veterinary Sciences PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD or MSc by Research in Clinical Veterinary Sciences at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme focuses on the improvement of health and welfare of domestic animal species, and public health.
Collections and Curating Practices MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study MSc by Research in Collections and Curating Practices at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme combines advanced research in and on collections with practices, including archival work and temporary exhibition organisation.
Comparative Literature PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to the study of comparative literature.
Condensed Matter PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
This group incorporates molecular and optical physics, and covers a world of applications, from computational materials physics to quantum ordering to soft matter physics.
Counselling Studies MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The MSc by Research programme in Counselling Studies offers advanced training and education to students interested in developing research skills, including qualified counselling and psychotherapy practitioners and social science researchers.
Counselling Studies PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The PhD Counselling Studies programme is an advanced research degree enabling students to conduct in-depth independent research on a topic of their choice, thereby contributing to the knowledge and evidence base for counselling and psychotherapy.
Creative Music Practice PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study the PhD in Creative Music Practice; an opportunity for you to pursue practice-led research in the field of music at the highest level.
Creative Writing (Poetry) PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study for a Creative Writing PhD (poetry) in a community of well-published, prize-winning writers.
Cultural Heritage PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Once understood as a conservative discipline, cultural heritage is emerging as a set of experimental practices. The Cultural Heritage PhD offers a way to engage with these multidisciplinary considerations and to benefit from synoptic insights when addressing them.
Cyber Security, Privacy and Trust PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
This PhD programme in Cyber Security, Privacy and Trust is a response to the growing need for highly specialized research and training in these topics.
Back to top
D
Design PhD, MPhil
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD or MPhil in Design at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme expertise areas include animation, design informatics, fashion, film and TV, graphic design, illustration, interior design, jewellery, product design, textiles.
Digital Communications MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The MScR Digital Communications programme enables you to complete a research degree as part of the Institute for Imaging, Data and Communications (IDCOM), the UK's leading research institute in signal processing and communications.
Doctor of Medicine MD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study Doctorate in Medicine at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme is undertaken by clinically qualified staff, normally during their postgraduate medical training.
Back to top
E
East Asian Studies PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to East Asian studies.
Economic and Social History MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Our MSc (by Research) in Economic and Social History offers you the opportunity to study at an advanced level through a mix of taught independent research.
Economic and Social History PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The PhD in Economic and Social History offers you the opportunity to study economic and social history at an advanced level through independent research.
Economics PhD with Integrated Study
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
Study PhD in Economics at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme enables you to pursue your academic interests and learn the latest methods in research, while providing you with thorough training in modern economics.
Education MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Our research-based MScR programme allows you to make a significant contribution to knowledge in, and understanding of, your chosen field.
Education PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Our research-based Education PhD allows you to make a significant contribution to knowledge in, and understanding of, your chosen field.
Energy Systems MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The MScR Energy Systems programme enables you to complete a research degree as part of the Institute for Energy Systems (IES), a multidisciplinary research institute delivering world-leading research in low-carbon energy systems, technology and policy.
Engineering PhD, MPhil
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
A research degree programme in Engineering at the University of Edinburgh is your chance to connect with internationally renowned researchers and innovators while developing high-quality training in research skills. Conduct your postgraduate research as a member of one of our seven Research Institutes.
English Language MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
This programme offers the opportunity to focus in detail on an area of your choosing in the synchronic or diachronic study of English, while still being able to take some taught courses.
English Literature MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a short piece of postgraduate research in English literature. On this Masters by Research programme, you'll develop your critical skills and achieve a masters through independent study.
English Literature PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to English Literature - literature written in English from around the world.
EPCC: High Performance Computing, Computational & Data Science, Software Engineering PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
EPCC (formerly the Edinburgh Parallel Computing Centre) offers the opportunity to study for a PhD in areas related to high performance computing, computational and data Science, software engineering and sustainability, and parallelism.
Ethics and Practical Theology PhD, MPhil
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study our postgraduate degree programme in Ethics and Practical Theology at the University of Edinburgh. Our programmes include the study of public and political theology, theology and ethical theory, and contemporary ethical issues.
European Theatre PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to the study of European theatre.
Back to top
F
Film Studies PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to film studies.
Finance PhD with Integrated Study
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
A four-year doctoral programme combining rigorous coursework and original research, designed to develop future scholars in finance across areas such as asset pricing, corporate finance, and financial markets.
Financial Technology PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
Our PhD in Financial Technology offers a research programme at the intersection of finance/economics and informatics/technology.
French MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a short piece of postgraduate research in French and Francophone studies. On this Masters by Research programme, you'll develop your critical skills and achieve a masters through independent study.
French PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to French and Francophone studies.
Functional Genetics and Development PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD or MSc by Research in Functional Genetics and Development at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme aims to characterise, understand and ultimately exploit the ever-changing profile of gene expression found in mammals.
Back to top
G
Genetics and Genomics PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD or MSc by Research in Genetics & Genomics at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme aims to advance understanding of complex animal systems. Expertise lies in mathematical biology, molecular genetics, and physiology.
Genetics and Molecular Medicine PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD or MSc by Research in Genetics and Molecular Medicine at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme has strengths in genetics, molecular biology, biochemistry and cell biology, with a strong focus on computational biology.
Geology and Geophysics PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study for a PhD in Geology and Geophysics at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme encompasses the major disciplines of geology, geochemistry, geodynamics, meteorology and geophysics. Expertise lies in mineralogy, tectonics, and seismic imaging.
GeoSciences (Individual Project - Taught Pathway) MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
This programme offers you a unique opportunity to conduct independent research in key areas of Geosciences, spanning Human and Physical Geography, Atmospheric and Environmental Science, Geology and Geophysics.
GeoSciences (Individual Project) MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study MSc by Research in GeoSciences (Individual Project) at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme covers most major branches of geosciences: human and physical geography, atmospheric science, climate change, ecological sciences, environmental sustainability, geology, meteorology, glaciology.
German MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a short piece of postgraduate research in German studies. On this Masters by Research programme, you'll develop your critical skills and achieve a masters through independent study.
German PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to German studies.
Global Health PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study for a PhD or MSc by Research in Global Health at the Usher Institute. We offer postgraduate research degrees using quantitative, qualitative or mixed-methods approaches in various disciplines.
Global Health Policy PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD in Global Health Policy at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme looks at commercial sector and public health, health systems and global governance, public policy science, advocacy and health policy.
Back to top
H
Health in Social Science PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The PhD Health in Social Science provides the opportunity to carry out a substantial piece of research in an area that explores health and wellbeing through the lens of arts and humanities practice and knowledge.
Hebrew and Old Testament Studies PhD, MPhil
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD/MPhil/MScR in Hebrew and Old Testament Studies at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme covers pentateuchal and historical studies, poetry and prophecy, biblical theology and ethics, Hebrew language and Septuagint.
History MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The MSc by Research in History offers you the opportunity to undertake a substantial piece of supervised independent research in your chosen field.
History of Art MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study MSc by Research in History of Art at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme is suitable for those with a good background in history of art and a strong interest in a specific area of research.
History of Art PhD, MPhil
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD in History of Art at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme offers a broad range of option courses designed to focus your interest on a specific area of research.
History of Christianity PhD, MPhil
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD in History of Christianity at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme strengths lie in early Christian history; the reformation in Britain; puritanism; history of British and European Christianity; and the history of Christian missions.
History PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The PhD in History offers you the opportunity to study history at an advanced level through independent research.
Human Geography and Environmental Sciences PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study for a PhD in Human Geography and Environmental Sciences at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme draws on expertise from the School’s Human Geography Research Group and spans humanities, social sciences and natural sciences.
Back to top
I
Infection and Immunity PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD or MSc by Research in Infection and Immunity at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programmes include studies of host/pathogen interactions, the immune systems of animals, genetic resistance to disease and epidemiology of disease.
Infection Medicine PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD Infection Medicine at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme looks at pathway biology of infection and immunity, and biochip medicine in systemic response to disease.
Infectious Diseases MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
Gain hands-on laboratory research experience in infectious diseases and prepare for PhD study or careers in biomedical, healthcare and life sciences.
Inflammation PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study for a PhD in Inflammation Research at The University of Edinburgh, School of Regeneration and Repair. This postgraduate doctoral programme is hosted at the Institute for Regeneration and Repair (IRR), Centre for Inflammation Research (CIR).
Informatics: AIAI: Foundations and Applications of Artificial Intelligence, Automated Reasoning, Agents, Data Intensive Research PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
At the Artificial Intelligence and its Applications Institute (AIAI), we enable computer systems to reproduce and complement human abilities, work with people and support collaboration between humans.
Informatics: ICSA: Computer Architecture, Compilation and System Software, Networks and Communication PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The Institute for Computing System Architecture's (ICSA) research areas include compilers and architectures, parallel computing, computer networking, systems software and operating systems, and machine learning systems.
Informatics: ILCC: Language Processing, Speech Technology, Information Retrieval, Cognition PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Strongly interdisciplinary in nature, the Institute for Language, Cognition and Communication (ILCC) is dedicated to both basic and applied research in the computational study of language, communication, and cognition, in both humans and machines.
Informatics: IML: Machine Learning, Computational Neuroscience, Computational Biology PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The Institute for Machine Learning (IML) is a world-leading institute dedicated to the theoretical and empirical study of adaptive processes in both artificial and biological systems.
Informatics: IPAB: Robotics, Computer Vision, Computer Graphics and Animation PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The Institute of Perception, Action and Behaviour (IPAB) focuses on how to link computational perception, representation, transformation and generation processes to external worlds, in theory and in practice.
Informatics: LFCS: Theory and Foundations of Computer Science, Databases, Software and Systems Modelling MScR, PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The Laboratory for Foundations of Computer Science (LFCS) continues to lead the way in the development of mathematical models, algorithms, theories and tools that probe the possibilities of computation and communication.
Infrastructure and the Environment MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The MScR Infrastructure and the Environment programme enables you to complete a research degree as part of the Institute for Infrastructure and Environment, contributing to efficient, sustainable and resilient infrastructure in the built and natural environments.
Integrated Micro and Nano Systems (IMNS) MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
The MScR Integrated Micro and Nano Systems programme enables you to complete a research degree as part of the Institute for Integrated Micro and Nano Systems (IMNS), combining technology and chip design to address applications in biomedical, biomimetic, quantum, energy, advanced and neural computation.
Integrative Biomedical Sciences (Based in China) MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
Join a one-year full-time University of Edinburgh Masters by Research programme in Integrative Biomedical Sciences based at the award winning Zhejiang University-University of Edinburgh Institute (ZJE) at Zhejiang University’s International Campus in Haining, China. Our programme will provide you with experience in a broad range of techniques and methodological approaches by participation in two independent research projects covering the full range of biomedical sciences.
Integrative Biomedical Sciences (Based in China) PhD
Postgraduate research
Study our Dual Award PhD programme in Integrative Biomedical Sciences (Based in China) with the University of Edinburgh and Zhejiang University. This five-year postgraduate research programme looks at a wide range of Biomedical Sciences methods and how fundamental research translates from lab-based approaches to human subjects.
Integrative Neuroscience MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
A one-year, intensive, research-focused neuroscience programme offering broad interdisciplinary training, specialist taught courses and substantial project-based research experience within Edinburgh’s vibrant neuroscience community, preparing students for PhD or research careers.
Integrative Physiology (Biomedical Sciences - Centre for Discovery Brain Sciences) PhD, MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD or MSc by Research in Integrative Physiology at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme aims to understand mechanisms relevant to brain and body function in health and disease.
Intermediality PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to the study of intermediality.
International Development PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study PhD in International Development at the University of Edinburgh. Our postgraduate degree programme looks at policy and health, science and technology, religion, migration, urbanisation and human rights, among other areas, in relation to international development.
Islamic and Middle Eastern Studies (IMES) MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a short piece of postgraduate research in Islamic and Middle Eastern Studies. On this Masters by Research programme, you'll develop your critical skills and achieve a masters through independent study.
Islamic and Middle Eastern Studies (IMES) PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to Islamic and Middle Eastern Studies (IMES).
Islamic Studies and Christian-Muslim Relations PhD, MPhil
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Study our postgraduate degree programme in Islamic Studies and Christian-Muslim Relations at the University of Edinburgh. Our PhD or MPhil offers an exciting interdisciplinary approach to Islamic thought and practice, and of historical, theological, ethical and political encounters between Christianity and Islam.
Italian MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a short piece of postgraduate research in Italian studies. On this Masters by Research programme, you'll develop your critical skills and achieve a masters through independent study.
Italian PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to Italian studies.
Back to top
J
Japanese MScR
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a short piece of postgraduate research in Japanese studies. On this Masters by Research programme, you'll develop your critical skills and achieve a masters through independent study.
Japanese PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time, Part-time
Complete a PhD and make an original, positive and lasting contribution to Japanese studies.
Back to top
K
Korean Studies MScR

Particle Physics PhD
Postgraduate research
Delivery: Full-time
Particle physics studies the most elementary building blocks of matter. By studying the basic forces of nature, we aim to understand how these fundamental particles interact and bind together to form more familiar objects (like the proton or the neutron), how they decay from one form to another and how they influenced the evolution of the very early Universe. The goal of the subject is to discover the law of nature in their most fundamental form, and to understand how the Universe we see around us emerges from these fundamental laws.
The subject relies on experiments ranging from huge particle accelerators (such as the LHC), orbiting satellites (e.g. WMAP and Planck), terrestrial detectors, underground laboratories and simulations using powerful supercomputers, as well as on the creative ideas of individial scientists.
